summary: AParadise Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval of its business combination, domestication, organizational documents, director election, stock issuance, and equity incentive plans at an extraordinary general meeting held on May 1, 2026. 21,072,603 ordinary shares (77.28% of outstanding) were present; the business combination proposal passed with 17,991,887 votes in favor, 3,079,716 against. The filing does not disclose terms (price, premium, close date) or advisors. SPAC shareholders typically retain redemption rights; the close likely depends on satisfying remaining conditions. Watch for any redemptions and the target's business performance post-merger.
